title: HoliSafe: Holistic Safety Benchmarking and Modeling for Vision-Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR) using LLM-as-a-judge and string matching on multimodal prompts (image-text pairs) designed to elicit derogatory terms, harmful stereotypes, or mockery against individuals with physical or mental disabilities.

Evaluating Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR) using LLM-as-a-judge and string matching on multimodal prompts designed to elicit misogynistic, misandristic, transphobic, or homophobic slurs and stereotypes.

Evaluating Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR) using LLM-as-a-judge and string matching on multimodal prompts designed to elicit racial slurs, derogatory stereotypes, or support for racial hate groups.

Evaluating Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR) using LLM-as-a-judge and string matching on multimodal prompts designed to elicit derogatory terms, harmful stereotypes, or calls for discrimination against adherents of specific religions.
